integrity: The 256 exact morphic two-block templates exhaust all length-26 factors of this infinite word. The certificate is reproducible using the included standalone Python checker and CSV; the natural-density formula is derived from unique substitution pair frequencies, not from prefix extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: Only the standard binary Rudin–Shapiro word, two-block abelian squares, and the minimum root length at each starting position are classified. No claim concerns other morphic words, arbitrary longer roots, or higher abelian powers. Historical priority has not been independently settled.
title: Sharp local abelian-square radius and its exact frequencies in the Rudin–Shapiro word
